per.section: The tick verdict — one facts artifact

acceptance: each agent's usage row reaches disk when that agent returns, so a tick that dies after paying for an agent keeps that agent's row; the tick verdict's `invocations[]` composes from those rows and holds no second copy of them
tests: an agent's usage row reaches disk when that agent returns rather than when its tick ends
a tick that dies after an agent returned keeps that agent's usage row
the tick verdict's invocations compose from the usage rows already on disk
notes: Ruled in the inbox (2): spend already paid is state on disk, never a total held in memory until the tick settles. `contractTouching`: the rows are a state-root path two tick children under one supervisor write as one.
